about: Mylanta Double Strength (aluminium hydroxide with magnesium hydroxide and simethicone), by brand name only, is supplied six times from March to October 2026 to a 72-year-old woman.

Mylanta FastChews (calcium carbonate with magnesium hydroxide) chewable tablets are supplied three times from 13 January 2026 to 12 March 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, to a 69-year-old man.
Alu-Tab is supplied solely to bind phosphate with meals. The Gaviscon Dual Action supplies contain neither magnesium hydroxide nor aluminium.
